description: BulkPublish is a social media scheduling and bulk-publishing tool. In ChatGPT you can see which social accounts are connected, draft or schedule a post to one or several of them at once, upload an image or video for it, publish a draft straight away, move or retry a post, find the next open slot in your posting queue, and read how recent posts performed. It publishes to Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and more.

defaultPrompt: Draft a post for several platforms without publishing.
Schedule a post into the next open queue slot for our X and LinkedIn accounts.
Look at how our recently published posts have performed.
